_comment: First cream config, 2026-08-19. Carries every fix the Glutathione run exposed. Jar wording read off refs/product_tight.png; carton wording read face by face off the dieline PDRN-Collagen-Repair-Cream-Skingenetix.ai, not from memory or from the handover's summary table. The cream cartons carry no known artwork error - 50ML is correct for a cream.
product_desc: Skingenetix PDRN Collagen Repair Deep Renewal Treatment: a 50ml frosted SOFT PINK glass cosmetic jar, wide and squat - noticeably WIDER THAN IT IS TALL, about 1.15 times wider than its full height - with a deep brushed satin ALUMINIUM screw lid. The lid is a tall band standing about a THIRD of the jar's total height and roughly HALF the height of the glass body beneath it; it is not a thin disc or a shallow cap. The lid has a fine vertical brushed grain and is satin, never a chrome mirror. The metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY and stays neutral next to the coloured glass - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted. The glass is frosted pale rose-pink, deeper at the shoulders and lighter towards the base - keep it PINK and do not render it white, amber, gold or peach. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. The colour words below describe the INK each line is printed in and must never themselves appear as text on the product: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical ROSE rule down the left of the text block; 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' in BLACK bold capitals on ONE line; 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in ROSE capitals; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in BLACK light capitals; and 'PDRN  |  COLLAGEN  |  COPPER PEPTIDE  |  50ML' in small BLACK capitals at the base. The volume is 50ML. THE JAR LABEL CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE. It does NOT carry the benefit triplet 'PLUMPING | FIRMING | REPAIRING', nor 'ALL SKIN TYPES', nor any ingredient list - those belong to the carton only, and printing them on the jar is wrong. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: this product's brand colour is ROSE - a soft dusty antique pink. Wherever a shot calls for a brand colour, brand gradient or accent glow, build it from that rose and warm neutrals. Never gold, purple, blue, green or orange.
_packaging_desc_help: Written face by face because a model renders a box in one colour unless told otherwise. The cream carton is a WIDE SHORT box, unlike the tall slim serum carton. Source: the dieline, which also specifies the two stock finishes by name.
packaging_desc:
The product carton is a WIDE, SHORT rectangular box - broader than it is tall, sized to hold a squat 50ml jar, quite unlike a tall slim serum carton. It has TWO large faces in different colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. One large face is matte metallic soft dusty pink; the other is matte metallic brushed pale silver - not white cardboard, not a mirror. Both large faces carry the SAME five lines of text, in this order top to bottom, and these are the ONLY words printed on them:
1. the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'
2. 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' - bold capitals, one line
3. 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT'
4. 'PLUMPING  |  FIRMING  |  REPAIRING'
5. 'PREMIUM FORMULA  |  ALL SKIN TYPES'
6. 'PDRN  |  COLLAGEN  |  COPPER PEPTIDE  |  50ML' - small capitals
A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block.
INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words. On the pink face: lines 1, 3 and the 'ALL SKIN TYPES' half of line 5 are printed in white ink, the vertical rule is white, and everything else is printed in black ink. On the silver face: those same elements are printed in rose ink and the rule is rose, everything else black. No colour name - not white, silver, rose, pink, gold or black - ever appears as text on the packaging.
The narrow side panels are printed in the same pink and silver and carry ingredient and directions text too small to read - render it as fine unreadable print, never as placeholder words. FINISH: the dieline specifies a luxury matte-metallic satin stock. Render a soft brushed sheen with broad diffuse falloff across each face - never a mirror, never reflective foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING NOT LISTED ABOVE - do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
_refs_local_help: product_tight.png MUST stay first - Luma reads refs[0] and nothing else, and on a product shot the bottle is what it must get right. logo_mark.png follows: it is the brand artwork at native size, added 2026-08-20 because engines kept substituting a ribbon or an X for the DNA helix and splitting the wordmark's weight. On a product shot the helix is about 70px and soft, which is not enough to copy. Luma will ignore it; the multi-reference engines will not. pack_full.png stays excluded - the equivalent Glutathione crop carried a superseded label.
